baseline.rule: Do not seed this ledger with remembered or approximate channel metrics. Capture a dated evidence-backed baseline when the first acquisition experiment is actually activated.

measurement_rules.nullable_metric_rule: Use null when a metric is not actually measurable from available evidence. Do not convert missing data to zero.
measurement_rules.attribution_rule: Record only joins/enquiries that the declared measurement method can support. Do not infer attribution from timing alone.
measurement_rules.retention_rule: Retention fields are optional evidence fields, not guaranteed provider metrics. Populate them only when a reviewed measurement method can support the cohort calculation.

experiment_schema.source_id: must exist in the source registry or be a reviewed instance of an approved dynamic namespace
experiment_schema.measurement_method: declared method and evidence source; required before active
experiment_schema.started_at: ISO-8601 timestamp or null while planned
experiment_schema.spend_rub: number or null for non-paid source
experiment_schema.content_or_placement_ref: exact post/page/QR/partner placement identifier or null while planned
experiment_schema.evidence_refs: array of immutable or dated evidence references
experiment_schema.decision: keep | iterate | stop | inconclusive | null before review

review_windows.early_read: Use a short early read only to catch broken links, obvious mismatch or abuse; do not declare a source successful from a few hours of data.
review_windows.retention_read: Prefer a later cohort read when the measurement method supports it, especially for paid/local placement tests.
review_windows.commercial_read: Commercial attribution may lag acquisition; keep enquiry/order evidence separate from subscriber-count vanity metrics.
